references.title: DWDS: dass
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; Konjunktion (old spelling daß); Etymologie: the demonstrative das turned subordinator

notes.rationale: hörte sie wieder, daß es ..., cited in its standard spelling. DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word, and indeclinable, so it has no Ending, not even ∅ (ADR 0051): the Root dass alone.
